name: Chord & Rhythm Combos
instructions: Try playing a chord with your left hand while your right hand plays a simple melody -- the core skill behind most piano playing.
Start with your left hand playing just the root note in a steady rhythm, then add the full chord once that feels stable.
Keep both hands relaxed -- tension in one hand often shows up as tension (and mistakes) in the other.
Revisit today's chords-and-rhythm video as a reference.
